overview: Sweden is the largest country in northern Europe, on the Scandinavian peninsula. Its capital and largest city is Stockholm, which is built on a group of islands. Sweden is a constitutional monarchy. It joined the European Union in 1995 and, after two centuries of staying out of military alliances, joined NATO in 2024.

geography.text: Forests cover around two-thirds of Sweden, and it has close to a hundred thousand lakes. The north, reaching beyond the Arctic Circle, is mountainous and thinly populated, while the south is flatter and has most of the farmland and cities. Its long Baltic coastline is fringed with thousands of islands.
